_comment: THE PATH-AUTHORITATIVE INDEX for the foley library: what exists, and where. Split out of foley.json because that file is a bare {set: entry} map that consumers iterate with Object.entries — a layout key added to it becomes a phantom set and throws (wiki/build.mjs:2044). foley.json keeps the QA/feature data; this keeps the file list.
_root_comment: Repo-root-relative directory holding every path below. JOIN it rather than hardcoding a location: the library is moving to sounds/ so a dedicated sound agent can own one directory, and this field is how that move happens without breaking a consumer.
